text_snippet: African Journal of Science, Technology and Mathematics Education (AJSTME) Department of Science Education, University of Nigeria, Nsukka ISSN: 2251-0141 "> African Journal of Science, Technology and Mathematics Education (AJSTME) Welcome to AFRICAN JOURNAL OF SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY AND MATHEMATICS EDUCATION (AJSTME) AFRICAN JOURNAL OF SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY AND MATHEMATICS EDUCATION (AJSTME) ISSN: 2971-6233 (Print) 2251-0141 (Online) African Journal of Science, Technology and Mathematics Education (AJSTME) is an official journal of the Department of Science Education, University of Nigeria, Nsukka-Nigeria. The Journal publishes articles concerned with research innovation in knowledge of Science, Technology and Mathematics (STM), curriculum, evaluation, policy and pedagogy. Call for Papers! The editorial board of AJSTME calls for submission of a well-researched papers for publication consideration in the forthcoming issue. Click on Read More for details
